definitions.explanation: A narrow flow of water, smaller than a river. A literary word found in written descriptions of landscape and in geographical writing rather than in conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{林|はやし}→林：01702_hayashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{細流|さいりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: A small stream runs through the woods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと、⟦{斜面|しゃめん}→斜面：12870_shamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧いくつ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{細流|さいりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After the rain, several rivulets formed on the slope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{細流|さいりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{下流|かりゅう}→下流：15029_karyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The river, no more than a rivulet up in the mountains, is over a hundred meters wide downstream.

notes:
{細|さい} (fine, narrow) + {流|りゅう} (flow, current). A written word; in speech people say ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧ or ⟦{小川|おがわ}→小川：06695_ogawa⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細流|さいりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: a small stream flows
- {細流|さいりゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たどる: to follow a small stream
- {山中|さんちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{細流|さいりゅう}: a mountain rivulet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小川|おがわ}→小川：06695_ogawa⟧: brook — the everyday word, warm and familiar
- ⟦{渓流|けいりゅう}→渓流：15855_keiryuu⟧: mountain stream — a fast stream in a valley, associated with fishing
- ⟦{支流|しりゅう}→支流：19624_shiryuu⟧: tributary — defined by joining a larger river, regardless of size
